articles.title: Agentic AI adoption races ahead of governance readiness, warns Gartner
articles.summary: With AI adoption outpacing organisations’ ability to govern the risks, Gartner said chief information officers (CIOs) face the challenge of ensuring business value doesn’t come at the cost of growing risks

articles.title: Rising voice AI adoption creates new hiring demand for FDEs
articles.summary: Globally, job postings for Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) rose 729% year-on-year between April 2025 and April 2026, according to Indeed data. In India, postings surged 1,807% YoY in June 2026.

articles.title: Helsing built an AI system that prepares targets for weapons systems and says every decision will carry a human name
articles.summary: Helsing has unveiled Clarity, an AI platform that uses agents to distill sensor data into target recommendations for weapons systems, all under human oversight and European control. But experience from the Iran war, Gaza, and a near-miss involving China shows that the speed of automation and data fusion create risks that are hard to contain.
